description: Delegate a whole task to a Claude Code session in the shared workspace. It runs headless with tools Read, Edit and Bash, may spend up to $2 (400k tokens, 40 turns) per call, and answers with a JSON report: status, summary, artifacts, assumptions, events. Pass `session` from a previous report to continue it.

budget.description: A tightening of the registered task bound.

cost_microusd.description: At or under the configured cost bound.

turns.description: At or under the configured turn bound.

tools.description: The CLI-native tool names this session may use. Must be a subset of the configured set.

workspace.description: A path relative to the configured workspace root; the child's `cwd`. Absent is the root itself.

session.description: The session id a previous reply reported. Unknown to the CLI is `error.provider` with the CLI's own text.

workspace.description: See [`Request::Run`]; the same workspace as the original run.
